title: CIS 110 or WRD 110 (Composition and Communication I)
description: A first-year course in composition and communication: academic reading, writing, research, and oral and visual presentation.
notes: Choice slot: UK's CIS 110 or WRD 110 (the same course offered by two departments). Official descriptions are in data/raw/uky/courses/.

title: CIS 111 or WRD 111 (Composition and Communication II)
description: The second first-year composition and communication course: research-based writing and presentation on public issues.
notes: Choice slot: UK's CIS 111 or WRD 111. Official descriptions are in data/raw/uky/courses/.

title: UK Core - Social Sciences
description: A general education course on how individuals, groups, and societies behave, from a field such as psychology, sociology, economics, or political science.

title: Science Elective
description: A natural science or social science course chosen from the university's general education lists or approved by the department.
notes: UK [S]: 3 hours from the UK Core natural or social science lists.

title: UK Core - Humanities
description: A general education course in the humanities, such as literature, philosophy, history, or the arts, focused on interpreting texts and ideas.

title: CS 321 or MA 321 or MA 322 (Introduction to Numerical Methods)
description: A computational mathematics course: numerical methods (root finding, interpolation, numerical integration, linear systems) or matrix algebra and its applications.
notes: Choice slot: UK's CS 321 / MA 321 (cross-listed numerical methods) or MA 322 (matrix algebra). Official descriptions are in data/raw/uky/courses/.

title: Computer Science Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student, such as web programming, graphics, cryptology, databases, or artificial intelligence.
notes: UK [C]: 15 hours of 300-level and above CS, three from a listed set.

title: Technical Elective
description: An upper-level course in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, or business chosen by the student to broaden technical knowledge.
notes: UK [T]: 12 hours of 300-level or higher technical courses.

title: UK Core - Citizenship - US
description: A general education course on community, culture, and citizenship in the United States.

title: Natural Science Elective
description: A natural science course, such as biology, chemistry, geology, astronomy, or further physics.
notes: UK [N]: 3 hours from the UK Core natural science list.

title: Free Elective
description: Any course the student chooses that counts toward the degree, inside or outside the major.
notes: UK [E]: 7 hours, at least 3 outside CS, math, natural science, and engineering.

title: UK Core - Global Dynamics
description: A general education course on global issues, cultures, and societies outside the United States.
